mistakes: Downloading all 50 before testing one — scan a single test code first. A typo in the source data ruins the whole batch.
Encoding long URLs or paragraphs per line — dense codes scan poorly on cheap phones. Short lines scan fast and reliably.
Mixing URL formats in one list — some lines with https:// and some without creates an inconsistent, unprofessional set of codes.
Using low error correction for printed labels — print wears and tears codes. Use Q or H correction for anything printed.
Forgetting each PNG downloads separately — the tool doesn't make a ZIP. Plan for 50 individual downloads on big batches.
